rationale: Blocking is limited to fixable CRITICAL findings: un-fixable base-image noise would permanently red GA without adding security, while a fixable CRITICAL in a shipped image is a genuine release blocker.
scan_targets_rules: Image names only, never a tag: the certification round composes each one with the tag it built and loaded (CAP_CERT_IMAGE_TAG). A policy file that carries a tag is a second source of truth, and it went stale here once -- three targets named `:latest`, which no job builds, and GA-GATE 22 failed on the policy rather than on a finding.
allowlist_rules: An allowlist entry is a Trivy VulnerabilityID (CVE). Every entry MUST carry a written justification and a review date; empty entries are rejected by the gate.
